notes:
Pyramids and truncated solids, sizes picked with the mouse, and steadier previews.

### New
- Truncated cone: base centre, radius, end, then the top radius picked with a live preview or typed. Cone now always ends in a point.
- Pyramid and Truncated pyramid: Sides and Mode (Inscribed or Circumscribed) as in Polygon, then corner, end and, for the truncated one, the top size.
- Pipe: start radius and end radius, picked across the curve end or typed; the radius changes evenly along the curve. A wireframe tube follows the pointer while you pick.
- Extend surface: after the edge, pick the point to extend to or type the length.
- Rectangular array: after the counts, pick the unit cell (two corners, then a height) or type each spacing.

### Improved
- When you change an option, the last preview stays on screen, dimmed, until the new one is ready, instead of disappearing.
- Option values stay visible on the command bar while a tool recalculates.
- The unsaved-changes dot is larger, centred on the file name and closer to it.
- Pipe and solid previews report the real surface area.

### Fixed
- In plan views, a height given with the mouse for cones and pyramids was lost at the next step.
- Typing an option right after a command had finished could cause an error.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
